review_scope: Paired technical inspection of the 23 physical-surface views at the same named stations. Retained surface visibility and differences are described per frame. Human play, artistic acceptance, exact optical equivalence and performance are outside this capture review.

images.observation: Pendant pool, timber floor, rug and room fittings retain their surface separation. The small floor effect is present and leaves the surrounding grain visible.
The lamp spot reaches the tile with continuous grout and an intact curtain edge. The tight view does not show the full room.
Timber strips, rug edge, window surround and warm wall finish read in both frames. The resident and device do not obscure the main surface comparison.
Window trim, warm floor and joinery read in the candidate. The left chair is closer to the frame edge than in the main capture.
The backsplash remains patchy under the concentrated light in both arms. The candidate shows a darker band at the foot of the back wall. Both cabinet faces remain visible.
Casing, brass dial and the floor mat remain distinct. The right wall limits sight of the boiler bay.
Books, shelf edges and door surround remain separate. The desk leg and nearby shadows are darker in the candidate.
Glazed tile courses and the pipe run align. The lid and dark rail remain visibly separate.
Close dark brickwork remains present. The framing cannot verify the dumbwaiter opening or hardware.
Open cover, fuses and conduits remain distinct. The candidate shifts the cover and surrounding shadows warmer.
Low framing retains the bar foot rail, floor tiles and pale supports. Deep shadow hides most forms behind the rail.
The shelf, picture frame and red silhouette are present in both arms. The dark shelf view leaves fine decoration unresolved.
Ceiling beam edges and exposed fittings remain visible under warm spill. The upward framing does not establish floor or character contact.
The bulkhead and mail slots remain installed. The candidate is darker across the panel and left frame, limiting fine label readability.
The fins, curtains and radiator fittings remain recognizable. The candidate reduces contrast at the window-side table. Functional radiator qualification comes from the native repair and reload run.
The paved landing, rail guards and roof door remain legible under the same warm ceiling pool.
Tank, support legs and roof silhouette remain coherent. The skyline and cloud layer stay visible behind them.
The lenses, wiring enclosure and wall board remain distinct. The case looks darker and the familiar green spill remains.
Corner tile grout and exposed mount remain continuous. The crop is limited to the closet corner.
The colored residue, spotlight and timber remain distinct around the radiator. The shot captures the presented residue surface without resolving its temporal behavior.
The organic strands retain contrast against the illuminated timber and radiator. The foreground occluder remains in both samples.
The kettle, crumb tray and counter remain visible. Toaster and canisters appear darker and more bronze in the candidate.
The station box is installed in both frames. Stronger wall spill in the candidate leaves the label and interior darker. Readability remains limited in both views.
